impact: Real as filed but already fixed: src/config.ts:20 carries the /gu flag (commit be56785) and tests-ts/unicode-parity.test.mjs:127-131 pins encodePath against CPython re.sub over astral code points (passing). Scope note: the trigger is astral-only — BMP non-ASCII paths (accented Latin, mainstream CJK) encoded identically in both implementations even before the fix; only non-BMP code points (emoji directory names, CJK Ext-B) produced the two-dash divergence, silently mis-attributing success-path project rows via both the codex cwd path and homeEnc prefix stripping.
resolution: Fixed in commit be56785 (T-004): the u flag was added to encodePath's regex (src/config.ts:20, now /[^A-Za-z0-9]/gu, with a comment citing this issue). Pinned by tests-ts/unicode-parity.test.mjs:127-131, which compares CORPUS.map(encodePath) against a live CPython re.sub oracle AND asserts the corpus distinguishes the un-flagged regex. Verified passing at triage 2026-07-31 (17/17). Both reachability paths (src/codex.ts:396 cwd, src/context.ts:215 homeEnc) route through the fixed function.
title: encodePath splits astral characters into two dashes; Python produces one
